title: Hostile turn-taking
description: Three interruptions plus a wrong premise stated as fact. Targets the post-barge-in context loss seen in the p2_sanika run, where the agent stopped cleanly but then restarted its own thread instead of answering what it had been interrupted with.

steps.name: cut in with a real question
steps.text: Ruko ruko, pehle ye batao, dsawi ke baad direct MBBS ho jaata hai na?

expect.note: Must stop AND answer the interrupting question. Correcting the wrong premise is the point; restarting its own sentence is the failure.

judge: The agent corrected the false premise that MBBS can be entered directly after 10th.
The agent answered the interrupting question rather than resuming its own sentence.

steps.name: cut in again immediately
steps.text: Haan par mera matlab hai ki mujhe science lena hi padega kya iske liye?

expect.note: Second consecutive interruption. Latency must not degrade.

judge: The agent answered whether science is required, rather than restarting its script.

steps.name: third cut-in, off topic
steps.text: Achha chhodo ye sab, aapko cricket pasand hai kya?

expect.note: Topic drift under interruption. Agent should hold the thread without being rude.

judge: The agent redirected back to career without being dismissive or rude.

steps.name: back on topic, check it recovered
steps.text: Theek hai wapas aate hain. Toh maine jo poocha tha doctor banne ke liye, uska kya?

expect.note: After the drift the agent must be back on the career thread, not still discussing cricket.

judge: The agent picked the medical thread back up.
The agent did not act confused about what was being referred to.
